title_as_printed: Motor progression trajectories and risk of mild cognitive impairment in Parkinson's disease: A latent class trajectory model from PPMI cohort

Task_Type.reason: Latent-class motor-trajectory subtypes and their Cox hazard ratios for incident MCI; no discrimination figure. T6 (cohort epidemiology) would be the only alternative.
Task_Type.quote: Cox proportional hazard models were applied to calculate hazard ratios for MCI

Category.reason: MDS-UPDRS-III clinical trajectories in the PPMI cohort; CSF, serum and genetic markers appear only as covariates (C3 secondary).

Validation_Type.reason: Association modelling only; no predictive model is validated.

Sample_N_Approx.quote: A 5-year cohort including 415 PD patients at baseline was collected from the Parkinson's Progression Markers Initiative.

notes: The population is Parkinson's disease MCI (PD-MCI), not AD-spectrum MCI. This matters for population-specificity filters, not for the six audited fields.
